name: state_format_events_opponent_scry_range
why: docs/state_format.md §5 library positions: the opponent sees B's scry 2 as a look at B's top two cards and the bottomed card as a pick from cards they cannot tell apart, a range ('a card from top positions 0-1 -> bottom 0'); B sees each card's identity and exact position (CR 701.22a; step 1 T4 observation events, --trace-events)
expect_order: ^EVENT: A seq=\d+ t1 look player=B library:B count=2 range=top0\+2 to=B src=h\d+ src=Preordain \[h0>h0 \? from=top0\] \[h0>h0 \? from=top1\]$
^EVENT: B seq=\d+ t1 look player=B library:B count=2 range=top0\+2 to=B src=h\d+ src=Preordain \[h0>h\d+ Daze from=top0\] \[h0>h\d+ Force of Will from=top1\]$
^EVENT: A seq=\d+ t1 zone_move library:B -> library:B count=1 src=h\d+ src=Preordain \[h0>h0 \? from=top0\+2 to=bottom0\]$
^EVENT: B seq=\d+ t1 zone_move library:B -> library:B count=1 src=h\d+ src=Preordain \[h\d+>h0 Daze from=top0 to=bottom0\]$
^EVENT: A seq=\d+ t1 zone_move library:B -> library:B count=1 src=h\d+ src=Preordain \[h0>h0 \? from=top0 to=top0\]$
